entries.title: Exodus 24:1
segments: ¶Now He said to Moses, "Come up to the LORD, you and Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel, and worship from afar.

entries.title: Exodus 24:2
segments: "And Moses alone shall come near the LORD, but they shall not come near; nor shall the people go up with him."

entries.title: Exodus 24:3
segments: So Moses came and told the people all the words of the LORD and all the judgments. And all the people answered with one voice and said, "All the words which the LORD has said we will do."

entries.title: Exodus 24:4
segments: And Moses wrote all the words of the LORD. And he rose early in the morning, and built an altar at the foot of the mountain, and twelve pillars according to the twelve tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 24:5
segments: Then he sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of oxen to the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 24:6
segments: And Moses took half the blood and put [it] in basins, and half the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

entries.title: Exodus 24:7
segments: Then he took the Book of the Covenant and read in the hearing of the people. And they said, "All that the LORD has said we will do, and be obedient."

entries.title: Exodus 24:8
segments: And Moses took the blood, sprinkled [it] on the people, and said, "This is the blood of the covenant which the LORD has made with you according to all these words."

entries.title: Exodus 24:9
segments: ¶Then Moses went up, also Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel,

entries.title: Exodus 24:10
segments: and they saw the God of Israel. And [there was] under His feet as it were a paved work of sapphire stone, and it was like the very heavens in [its] clarity.

entries.title: Exodus 24:11
segments: But on the nobles of the children of Israel He did not lay His hand. So they saw God, and they ate and drank.

entries.title: Exodus 24:12
segments: ¶Then the LORD said to Moses, "Come up to Me on the mountain and be there; and I will give you tablets of stone, and the law and commandments which I have written, that you may teach them."

entries.title: Exodus 24:13
segments: So Moses arose with his assistant Joshua, and Moses went up to the mountain of God.

entries.title: Exodus 24:14
segments: And he said to the elders, "Wait here for us until we come back to you. Indeed Aaron and Hur [are] with you. If any man has a difficulty, let him go to them."

entries.title: Exodus 24:15
segments: Then Moses went up into the mountain, and a cloud covered the mountain.

entries.title: Exodus 24:16
segments: Now the glory of the LORD rested on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. And on the seventh day He called to Moses out of the midst of the cloud.

entries.title: Exodus 24:17
segments: The sight of the glory of the LORD [was] like a consuming fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

entries.title: Exodus 24:18
segments: So Moses went into the midst of the cloud and went up into the mountain. And Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
